story.title: An independent leftover-prize desk.
story.body: Scratch Vault is an independent information tool. It ranks {{name}} scratch-off games from publicly posted remaining-prize counts so you can see which games still have meaningful prizes listed — and which ones to skip — before you buy. It does not sell tickets, take wagers, or pay prizes.

disc.whatBody: The Vault compiles publicly posted remaining-prize counts for instant games and ranks them with a heat score. Grand heat looks at jackpots still listed{{holdback}}. Medium heat looks at mid-tier prizes still posted, with extra weight on secondary prizes that typically scale with ticket price. Bust / avoid flags games with no effective listed top prize or a drained mid-tier.

disc.what2: It is operated independently by Webb Spinner Visions. It is a consumer information tool only. You cannot buy, scan, check, or redeem tickets here. No account on this site creates a lottery ticket, a wager, or a prize claim.
disc.warrantyTitle: No warranty and limits of liability
disc.not1: Not a lottery, casino, sportsbook, sweepstakes, or ticket seller.
disc.not2: Not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by any state lottery, including the Tennessee Education Lottery Corporation, or any retailer.
disc.not3: Not official Lottery artwork, logos, marks, or communications. Cards in the Vault are original Scratch Vault chrome that show the public game name, number, and price. They are not lottery tickets.
disc.not4: Not gambling advice, investment advice, tax advice, or legal advice.
disc.not5: Not a prediction that any specific ticket, pack, store, or county will win.
disc.not6: Not a system that improves, changes, or guarantees lottery odds.
disc.odds1: The overall odds printed on a ticket are set when the game is printed. Those odds do not change when prizes are claimed. A game can still be sold after its top prizes are gone. Remaining-prize tables change as tickets sell and as winners are reported.
disc.odds2: Remaining figures are estimates compiled from public tables. They are not a Lottery ruling and may be wrong for a given game or week.
disc.odds3: Sources include the Lottery’s public remaining-prizes table and other published public counts. Some games only list the top prize. Medium heat is then estimated. Counts can be late, incomplete, revised, or missing a store-level location. “2 left” does not mean a matching ticket is at a particular retailer.
disc.odds4: Using this app does not make a losing ticket more likely to win, and it does not make a winning ticket more likely. Lottery play is chance. Past remaining counts do not predict future results.
disc.ageFollow: Do not use this app to help anyone under the applicable lottery age obtain tickets. Follow {{name}} law, retailer rules, and any self-exclusion you have chosen.
disc.age2: The Vault is for personal, non-commercial information. You are responsible for how you use the rankings. Do not rely on this site as your only source before spending money.
disc.warranty1b: , without warranties of any kind, express or implied, including accuracy, completeness, merchantability, or fitness for a particular purpose. We do not warrant that remaining counts, heat scores, ticket faces, or help links are current or error-free.
disc.warranty2: To the fullest extent allowed by law, Webb Spinner Visions and its owners, employees, and contractors are not liable for losses, lost winnings, extra tickets purchased, or other damages that arise from using or being unable to use this information — including decisions to buy, skip, or keep playing a scratch-off game.
disc.warranty3: Nothing on this site is an offer to sell a lottery ticket or a solicitation to gamble. Prize payment is solely the responsibility of {{lottery}} under its rules.
disc.play1: Scratch-off tickets are a form of gambling. The house edge is built into every game. Most players lose money over time. Play only for entertainment, only with money you can afford to lose, and only for a time you have already decided is enough.
disc.playLi1: Set a budget before you go to the store. Stop when it is gone.
disc.playLi2: Do not chase losses. A “hot” ranking is not a reason to spend more than you planned.
disc.playLi3: Do not borrow money, skip bills, or hide tickets and receipts from people who depend on you.
disc.playLi4: Do not treat remaining-prize heat as a skill edge or a way to get even.
disc.playLi5: Take breaks. Walking away is always allowed.
disc.addiction1: Problem gambling is a recognized behavioral addiction. It can harm finances, work, health, and relationships. It can happen to anyone, including people who “only play scratch-offs.” Tools like heat maps can make play feel more skilled than it is. That feeling is not a reason to keep spending.
disc.addictionLi1: Spending more time or money than you planned
disc.addictionLi2: Chasing losses or thinking the next ticket will fix it
disc.addictionLi3: Borrowing, lying, or hiding tickets and receipts
disc.addictionLi4: Feeling restless, irritable, or depressed when not playing
disc.addictionLi5: Neglecting work, school, family, or bills
disc.addictionLi6: Using lottery play to escape stress or other problems
disc.addictionLi7: Others expressing concern about your play
disc.addiction2: If these sound familiar — for you or someone you care about — get help. You do not have to wait until things get worse. Recovery is possible.
disc.helpTnDept: TN Department of Mental Health — problem gambling programs
disc.helpCrisisA: If you are in immediate danger or thinking of harming yourself, call or text

pricing.faqTrialQ: How does the free trial work?
pricing.faqTrialA: Monthly only. Complete your profile, add a credit or debit card, and you get 7 days of Full Access. If you do not opt out in your profile before the trial ends, the first month is billed at $4.99 and then renews monthly. No card, no profile, no trial. Annual has no trial — $49.99 is billed now.
pricing.faqCancelA: Open Account and use Opt out of monthly payments or Opt out of next year’s charge. That stops the next bill. You keep access through the trial or paid period already started. There are no refunds. In the iOS or Android app, use the store’s subscription settings.
pricing.faqIncludesA: The official three-tier remaining-prize table, mid-tier leaders, the skip/bust list, heat scores, game-by-game remaining top and mid counts, and radar alerts when new remaining-prize data is ready to review. The free homepage still shows a teaser desk and the legal disclaimer.
pricing.faqLotteryQ: Is this affiliated with any lottery?
pricing.faqLotteryA: No. Scratch Vault is an independent information product of Webb Spinner Visions. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to any state lottery, including the Tennessee Education Lottery Corporation.
pricing.faqAgeA: Yes, 18 or older to use Scratch Vault. Lottery tickets are 21+ in Iowa, and 18+ in the other listed states. Remaining counts do not improve the odds of winning any prize. This tool does not sell tickets.
pricing.foot: 18+ only. Iowa lottery tickets are 21+. Independent information tool, not affiliated with any lottery. Remaining counts do not improve your odds. No refunds. Play responsibly. Scratch Vault Full Access is billed through Stripe on the web.

pricing.faqOptQ: What happens if I opt out?
pricing.faqOptA: Future charges stop. Monthly: if you opt out during the trial you are not billed $4.99. Annual: you keep the remaining months of the year you paid; the next $49.99 is not billed. Access never extends past the current period after you opt out.
